mapper.select: SELECT CHGBILL_ID AS chgbillId, RENTAL_PTY_ID AS rentalPtyId, UNIT_ID AS unitId, BLDG_ID AS bldgId, CHGBILL_CHARGE_MONTH AS chgbillChargeMonth, CHGBILL_AMOUNT AS chgbillAmount, CHGBILL_STATUS AS chgbillStatus, CHGBILL_STATUS_GRP_CD AS chgbillStatusGrpCd, CHGBILL_DUE_DATE AS chgbillDueDate, CHGBILL_PAID_DATE AS chgbillPaidDate, CHGBILL_DESC AS chgbillDesc FROM CHARGE_BILL WHERE UNIT_ID = #{unitId} AND CHGBILL_CHARGE_MONTH IN (#{previousMonth}, #{beforeLastMonth})

SELECT imf.INTG_FEE_ID AS intgFeeId, imf.INTG_FEE_AMOUNT AS intgFeeAmount, imf.INTG_FEE_MONTH AS chargeMonth,
cb.CHGBILL_ID AS chgbillId, cb.CHGBILL_AMOUNT AS chgbillAmount, cb.CHGBILL_STATUS AS chgbillStatus, statusCode.CODE_NAME AS chgbillStatusName, -- ✅ 이건 SELECT의 마지막으로 위치 조정
cb.CHGBILL_DUE_DATE AS chgbillDueDate,
hemu.TOTAL_ENERGY_USAGE_QTY AS energyUsageQty, hemu.TOTAL_ENERGY_CHARGE_AMT AS energyChargeAmount, ec.CODE_NAME AS energyTypeName,
residentMember.MBR_NM AS residentName, rentalPartyMember.MBR_NM AS rentalPartyName, b.BLDG_NM AS buildingName
FROM INTEGRATED_MANAGEMENT_FEE imf INNER JOIN CHARGE_BILL cb ON cb.UNIT_ID = imf.UNIT_ID AND cb.CHGBILL_CHARGE_MONTH = imf.INTG_FEE_MONTH
LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE statusCode -- ✅ 이렇게 FROM 이후에 JOIN 추가 ON statusCode.CODE_GROUP = 'IFSTA' AND statusCode.CODE_VALUE = cb.CHGBILL_STATUS
LEFT JOIN HOUSEHOLD_ENERGY_MONTHLY_USAGE hemu ON hemu.UNIT_ID = imf.UNIT_ID AND hemu.BLDG_ID = imf.BLDG_ID AND hemu.DUM_MONTH = imf.INTG_FEE_MONTH
LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE ec ON ec.CODE_GROUP = 'ENEG' AND ec.CODE_VALUE = hemu.ENEG_TYPE
LEFT JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT ur ON ur.UNIT_ID = imf.UNIT_ID
LEFT JOIN MEMBER residentMember ON residentMember.MBR_CD = ur.MBR_CD
LEFT JOIN TENANCY t ON t.RENTAL_PTY_ID = imf.RENTAL_PTY_ID
LEFT JOIN MEMBER rentalPartyMember ON rentalPartyMember.MBR_CD = t.MBR_CD
LEFT JOIN BUILDING b ON b.BLDG_ID = imf.BLDG_ID
WHERE imf.UNIT_ID = #{unitId} AND imf.INTG_FEE_MONTH = #{chargeMonth}
